title: Saltbush Landscape Co. | Sample Trade Website
description: A sample website for a local landscaping company: before and after, services, reviews and a free-estimate request. A concept by Tava Valenti.
sample_notice: This is a sample website for a made-up landscaping company, to show what a local business site can look like. Photos are AI-generated placeholders.
name: Saltbush Landscape Co.

hero.alt: A finished backyard at sunset: a stone patio with a fire pit, lavender, agave and an olive tree
hero.h1: Yards that look great and *use less water.*
hero.sub: Drought-tolerant landscaping, patios, irrigation and lighting for homes across North County San Diego. Family run, and we pick up the phone.

before_after.text: A tired front lawn in Oceanside, replaced with low-water plants, a flagstone path and boulders. Drag the line to compare.
before_after.aria: Before and after of a front yard: a dry brown lawn on the left, the finished drought-tolerant landscape on the right. Drag to compare.

services_head.text: Big project or small fix, you get one crew from start to finish and a clear price before any work begins.

services.alt: A coastal succulent garden with aloes and blue chalk sticks
services.title: Drought-tolerant gardens
services.text: Native and low-water plants that stay green with a fraction of the water.

services.alt: A paver patio with a cedar pergola and string lights
services.title: Patios & walkways
services.text: Pavers, flagstone and pergolas built for dinners outside.

services.alt: A backyard with artificial turf and a stone planter
services.title: Lawn replacement
services.text: Swap thirsty grass for turf, gravel or plants that suit how you use the yard.

services.alt: Gloved hands planting an agave next to drip irrigation
services.title: Irrigation & drip
services.text: Leak repair, drip conversions and smart timers that water only when needed.

services.alt: A stacked stone retaining wall on a sloped yard
services.title: Retaining walls
services.text: Stone and block walls that hold a slope and give you more usable yard.

services.alt: Warm landscape lighting on an olive tree and a path at dusk
services.title: Landscape lighting
services.text: Warm, low-voltage lights for paths, trees and the front of the house.

steps.text: No pressure and no surprise charges. You'll always know what's happening and what it costs.

items.title: Call or send photos
items.text: Tell us what you'd like changed. A few phone photos of the yard help a lot.

items.title: Free estimate at your home
items.text: We walk the yard with you and send a written, fixed price within two days.

items.title: We build it and clean up
items.text: Same crew every day. When it's done, we walk through it together.

gallery.alt: Backyard patio with fire pit at sunset
gallery.caption: Backyard, Carlsbad

about.alt: Planting an agave by hand next to new drip line
about.text: Saltbush is a small family company based in Oceanside. The owner meets you for the estimate and is on site while the work gets done, so there's always someone who knows your yard.

estimate.text: Send a few details and we'll call you back within one business day to set up a time.
estimate.placeholder: Size of the yard, timing, what you'd like it to look like...
